native_ternary_claim: Blog: pre-training 'simultaneously yields both non-quantized and quantized model variants'; ~1.5T tokens; BitNet b1.58 architecture with BitNet-internal layer norms removed; weights absmean-ternarized and activations int8 per-token absmax in TII's Triton training kernels.
normalization: RMSNorm (LlamaRMSNorm) x2 per layer: input_layernorm, post_attention_layernorm; plus final model.norm. No sub-norms (BitNet-internal norms removed per blog).
attention: Llama GQA, RoPE on q/k, no bias
weight_quantization: absmean ternary (scale=1/mean|W|, round, clamp[-1,1]); stored packed 2-bit (code = q+1) 4 per uint8 along dim 0; one BF16 weight_scale per tensor; scale convention: divide (weight_scale = 1/beta, output / weight_scale); checkpoint rounding: onebitllms quantize_to_1bit: torch round (half-to-even); training kernel floor(x+0.5)
activation_quantization: per-token (last dim) absmax symmetric int8: scale = 127/absmax, clamp[-128,127]; effective range [-127,127] (-128 unreachable); rounding: training kernel floor(x+0.5) (half-up); inference torch round (half-to-even); clamp [-128,127]; source: onebitllms kernels/activation_quant.py (training): scale = 127/row_absmax (min 1e-5), floor(x*scale+0.5), clamp [-128,127]; transformers BitLinear.activation_quant (inference)
